author: CC
prose: Stop copying 425MB of ~/.cairn twice per proof seal. Logs are 208MB of it and the aider shim's data is another 91MB. Bind those read-only instead of copying, and copy ~/.cairn once per batch with per-proof copies taken from that pristine snapshot. Bubblewrap 0.9.0 here has no overlay support, so a true copy-on-write swap needs an upgrade to 0.10 or later. This changes how much each reseal costs; the import-closure fingerprint changes how many happen. Akien 2026-09-06: 'i agree about your optimizations all the way thru.'
